name: Social
description: Posts for LinkedIn and other networks.

actions.name: LinkedIn post
actions.prompt:
MODE: LINKEDIN POST
Turn the text into a short LinkedIn post: a strong first line, two or three short paragraphs, no more than three relevant hashtags at the end. Sound like a real person, not a marketer. No emojis unless the original has some.

actions.name: Short post
actions.prompt:
MODE: SHORT POST
Rewrite the text as a single post of at most 280 characters that keeps the main point and the writer's voice.

actions.name: Catchy title
actions.prompt:
MODE: TITLE
Write one short, catchy title for the text, in its language. Return only the title.
